70002-the-eternal-savage.creator: Unknown
70002-the-eternal-savage.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Only so recently as the last darkness, as, beneath the great, equatorial moon, the two had walked hand in hand beside the restless sea she had made it quite plain to Nu, the son of Nu, that not even he, son of the chief of chiefs, could claim her unless there hung at the thong of his loin cloth the fangs of Oo.

arxiv-2101-12037.title: BENDR: using transformers and a contrastive self-supervised learning task to learn from massive amounts of EEG data.
arxiv-2101-12037.creator: Demetres Kostas, Stéphane Aroca-Ouellette, Frank Rudzicz
arxiv-2101-12037.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Demetres Kostas, Stéphane Aroca-Ouellette, Frank Rudzicz. Deep neural networks (DNNs) used for brain-computer-interface (BCI) classification are commonly expected to learn general features when trained across a variety of contexts, such that these features could be fine-tuned to specific contexts. While some success is found in such an approach, we suggest that this interpretation is limited and an alternative would better leverage the newly (publicly) available massive EEG datasets.

arxiv-2204-04432.title: Testing Screening Mechanisms with Mass Profiles of Galaxy Clusters
arxiv-2204-04432.creator: Lorenzo Pizzuti
arxiv-2204-04432.description: Abstract We present MG-MAMPOSSt , a license-free code to constrain modified gravity models by reconstructing the mass profile of galaxy clusters with the kinematics of the cluster’s member galaxies. We describe the main features of the code and we show the capability of the method when the kinematic information is combined with lensing data.

arxiv-2308-12243.title: Multi-Objective Optimization for Sparse Deep Multi-Task Learning
arxiv-2308-12243.creator: Anonymous submission, Sedjro S. Hotegni, Manuel Berkemeier, Sebastian Peitz
arxiv-2308-12243.description: Abstract Different conflicting optimization criteria arise naturally in various Deep Learning scenarios. These can address different main tasks (i.e., in the setting of Multi-Task Learning), but also main and secondary tasks such as loss minimization versus sparsity. The usual approach is a simple weighting of the criteria, which formally only works in the convex setting.

arxiv-2312-08638.title: Nonlinear optical responses in multi-orbital topological superconductors
arxiv-2312-08638.creator: Arpit Raj, Abigail Postlewaite, Swati Chaudhary, Gregory A. Fiete
arxiv-2312-08638.description: Abstract We theoretically study first and second-order optical responses in a transition metal dichalcogenide monolayer with distinct trivial, nodal, and time-reversal invariant topological superconducting (TRITOPS) phases. We show that the second-order DC response, also known as the photogalvanic response, contains signatures for differentiating these phases while the first-order optical response does not.

arxiv-2312-13973.title: On Products of Δ \Delta -sets
arxiv-2312-13973.creator: Rodrigo Carvalho, Vinicius Rodrigues
arxiv-2312-13973.description: Abstract . We prove the consistency of the existence of a Q Q -set whose square is not a Δ \Delta -set and that if there is a Δ \Delta -set, then there exists a Δ \Delta -set whose all finite powers are Δ \Delta -sets. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification: 54B10, 54D15, 03E35, 54H05.

arxiv-2401-00835.title: Observational predictions of some inflationary models
arxiv-2401-00835.creator: Daniel Pozo, Lenin Calvache, Esteban Orozco, Vicente A. Arévalo, Clara Rojas
arxiv-2401-00835.description: Abstract This paper presents the CMB angular power spectrum obtained using the CAMB code for three different models of inflation: the Starobinsky inflationary model, the generalized Starobinsky inflationary model, and the chaotic inflationary model with a step. The results are compared with the most recent data reported for the Planck mission.

arxiv-2403-10973.title: CETASim: A numerical tool for beam collective effect study in storage rings
arxiv-2403-10973.creator: Chao Li, Yong-Chul Chae
arxiv-2403-10973.description: Abstract We developed a 6D multi-particle tracking program CETASim in C++ programming language to simulate intensity-dependent effects in electron storage rings. The program can simulate the beam collective effects due to short-range/long-range wakefields for single/coupled-bunch instability studies. It also features to simulate interactions among charged ions and the trains of electron bunches, including both fast ion and ion trapping effects.

arxiv-2406-09484.title: Is Diffusion Model Safe? Severe Data Leakage via Gradient-Guided Diffusion Model
arxiv-2406-09484.creator: Jiayang Meng, Tao Huang, Hong Chen, Cuiping Li
arxiv-2406-09484.description: Abstract Gradient leakage has been identified as a potential source of privacy breaches in modern image processing systems, where the adversary can completely reconstruct the training images from leaked gradients. However, existing methods are restricted to reconstructing low-resolution images where data leakage risks of image processing systems are not sufficiently explored.

arxiv-2409-00934.title: New Upper bounds for KL-divergence Based on Integral Norms
arxiv-2409-00934.creator: Liu-Quan Yao, Song-Hao Liu
arxiv-2409-00934.description: Abstract In this paper, some new upper bounds for Kullback-Leibler divergence(KL-divergence) based on L 1 , L 2 L^{1},L^{2} and L ∞ L^{\infty} norms of density functions are discussed. Our findings unveil that the convergence in KL-divergence sense sandwiches between the convergence of density functions in terms of L 1 L^{1} and L 2 L^{2} norms.

arxiv-2412-06095.title: Measuring Grammatical Diversity from Small Corpora: Derivational Entropy Rates, Mean Length of Utterances, and Annotation Invariance
arxiv-2412-06095.creator: Fermín Moscoso del Prado Martín
arxiv-2412-06095.description: Abstract In many fields, such as language acquisition, neuropsychology of language, the study of aging, and historical linguistics, corpora are used for estimating the diversity of grammatical structures that are produced during a period by an individual, community, or type of speakers. In these cases, treebanks are taken as representative samples of the syntactic structures that might be encountered.

arxiv-2412-12586.title: The Keller-Segel model with mass critical exponent
arxiv-2412-12586.creator: Shen Bian, Yichen Zou
arxiv-2412-12586.description: Abstract We consider a Keller-Segel model with non-linear porous medium type diffusion and non-local attractive power law interaction, focusing on potentials that are less singular than Newtonian interaction. Here, the nonlinear diffusion is chosen to be m = 2 − 2 ​ s d m=2-\frac{2s}{d} , in which case the steady states are compactly supported.

arxiv-2504-02451.title: ConMo: Controllable Motion Disentanglement and Recomposition for Zero-Shot Motion Transfer
arxiv-2504-02451.creator: Jiayi Gao, Zijin Yin, Changcheng Hua, Yuxin Peng, Kongming Liang, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Guo, Yang Liu
arxiv-2504-02451.description: Abstract The development of Text-to-Video (T2V) generation has made motion transfer possible, enabling the control of video motion based on existing footage. However, current methods have two limitations: 1) struggle to handle multi-subjects videos, failing to transfer specific subject motion; 2) struggle to preserve the diversity and accuracy of motion as transferring to subjects with varying shapes.

pmc-10648425.title: Selected I-III-VI2 Semiconductors: Synthesis, Properties and Applications in Photovoltaic Cells
pmc-10648425.creator: Shubham Shishodia, Bilel Chouchene, Thomas Gries, Raphaël Schneider, Seiichi Miyazaki
pmc-10648425.description: I–III–VI2 group quantum dots (QDs) have attracted high attention in photoelectronic conversion applications, especially for QD-sensitized solar cells (QDSSCs). This group of QDs has become the mainstream light-harvesting material in QDSSCs due to the ability to tune their electronic properties through size, shape, and composition and the ability to assemble the nanocrystals on the surface of TiO2.

pmc-10674552.title: CNT-PUFs: Highly Robust and Heat-Tolerant Carbon-Nanotube-Based Physical Unclonable Functions †
pmc-10674552.creator: Florian Frank, Simon Böttger, Nico Mexis, Nikolaos Athanasios Anagnostopoulos, Ali Mohamed, Martin Hartmann, Harald Kuhn, Christian Helke, Tolga Arul, Stefan Katzenbeisser, Sascha Hermann, Hiroshi Furuta
pmc-10674552.description: In this work, we explored a highly robust and unique Physical Unclonable Function (PUF) based on the stochastic assembly of single-walled Carbon NanoTubes (CNTs) integrated within a wafer-level technology. Our work demonstrated that the proposed CNT-based PUFs are exceptionally robust with an average fractional intra-device Hamming distance well below 0.

pmc-11356006.title: Phylogenomic Analyses of Three Distinct Lineages Uniting Staphylococcus cohnii and Staphylococcus urealyticus from Diverse Hosts
pmc-11356006.creator: L. Caroline House, Amer Hasan, Andi Asnayanti, Adnan A. K. Alrubaye, Jeff Pummill, Douglas Rhoads
pmc-11356006.description: We sequenced and assembled genomes for 17 isolates of Staphylococcus cohnii isolated from osteomyelitis lesions in young broilers from two separate experiments where we induced lameness using a hybrid wire-litter flooring system. Whole genome comparisons using three different methods support a close relationship of genomes from both S. cohnii and Staphylococcus urealyticus.

pmc-12464698.title: Functional scaffolds design strategies for retinal repair and regeneration
pmc-12464698.creator: Pei Lin Chee, Ming Hao, Gaodan Liu, Pek Yin Michelle Yew, Eunjin Kim, Hang Liu, Thenapakiam Sathasivam, Guojie Xu, Zengping Liu, Dan Kai
pmc-12464698.description: The growing strain placed on both society and the healthcare system due to an ageing population should not be underestimated. Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of blindness worldwide and is projected to affect 288 million people globally by 2040. Current treatment options for AMD primarily focus on disease management rather than offering a definitive cure.

pmc-12613827.title: Influence of light, temperature, and nutrients on microcystin concentration during a winter cyanobacteria-dominated bloom
pmc-12613827.creator: Isabelle M Andersen, Katherine C Rusche, Maggie E Voyles, Alexandra J Bros, Lesley B Knoll, Beatrix E Beisner
pmc-12613827.description: Freshwater ecosystems are increasingly at risk of experiencing toxin-producing cyanobacterial blooms during the winter due to anthropogenic nutrient loading and climate change. However, understanding how increased light, temperature and nutrient levels impact cyanotoxin production during the winter is limited, as most research has historically focused on blooms during the summer and fall.

pmc-13187404.title: Effect of surface polishing on roughness, biofilm formation, and biocompatibility of LCD-printed denture base polymer
pmc-13187404.creator: Amanda Costa Ferro, Jonatas Silva de Oliveira, Lais Scabelo, Leonardo Viana Araújo, Carlos Mota, Matthew B Baker, Janaina Habib Jorge
pmc-13187404.description: This study investigated the effect of surface polishing on roughness, mechanical performance, and biological properties of a liquid crystal display (LCD)‑printed denture base polymer. Disc‑shaped samples of three-dimensional (3D) printing polymer were fabricated and allocated to polished (P) or not polished (NP) groups for comparative analysis.

pmc-13207157.title: Anti-Cell Staining Patterns in Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis-Associated Uveitis: A Peek Behind the Curtain
pmc-13207157.creator: Marijan Frkovic, Ivana Sabljak, Nada Tomic Sremec, Domagoj Kifer, Ana Kozmar, Sanja Peric, Marija Barisic Kutija, Iva Rukavina, Mario Sestan, Nastasia Kifer, Sanda Huljev Frkovic, Marija Jelusic

pmc-13383486.title: Accuracy, readability, and content coverage of AI-generated responses to questions on functional appliances
pmc-13383486.creator: Serene A Badran, Snigdha Pattanaik, Sarah Jumaah, Abdulrahman Salmeh, Meena Al-Saadi, Taiba Al-Mizban, Nadia Al-Zaidi, Abdullah Hanifa, Mahmoud K AL-Omiri

uslaw-usc-t31-s752.title: 31 U.S.C. § 752 — Chairman and General Counsel
uslaw-usc-t31-s752.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t31-s752.description: United States Code, Title 31 (Money And Finance); Chapter 7 (Government Accountability Office); Subchapter IV (Personnel Appeals Board). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The General Accounting Office Personnel Appeals Board 1 shall select one of its members as Chairman. The Chairman is the chief executive and administrative officer of the Board. (b) (1) The Comptroller General shall appoint as General Counsel.
